Starting point coordinates for the route.
Format: `longitude,latitude`

params.name: endPoint
params.description:
Ending point coordinates for the route.
Format: `longitude,latitude`

params.name: departAt
params.description:
Departure time for the route. Mutually exclusive with `arriveAt`.
When provided, `arrivalTimeUTC` is calculated as `departAt + route duration`.
Format: ISO 8601 UTC with "Z" suffix (e.g., 2026-03-13T15:00:00Z)

params.name: arriveAt
params.description:
Desired arrival time at the destination. Mutually exclusive with `departAt`.
When provided, `departureTimeUTC` is calculated as `arriveAt - route duration`.
Format: ISO 8601 UTC with "Z" suffix (e.g., 2026-03-13T16:00:00Z)

params.name: alternatives
params.description:
When "true", returns up to 3 alternative routes sorted by ascending duration.
When "false" or omitted, returns exactly 1 route.

items.docs:
Returns cacheable route geometry from the Mapbox Directions API as a GeoJSON FeatureCollection.
This endpoint decouples route geometry from weather/pavement data, enabling independent caching
of the route so the frontend can lock in a stable geometry for navigation (similar to Waze/Google Maps).

The `geojson` field in the response is directly compatible with the POST `/v2/pavement/conditions`
and POST `/v2/logistics` endpoints — it can be passed as the `route` body without transformation.
